goals.title: Meet Lyra at her house
goals.notes: Coord trigger at (11,7), one step left of the door (var 0x5102 gates it; 0 -> 2). The nav hops handle the bedroom stairs, the door mat and the New Bark warp.

goals.title: Receive the first Pokemon from Prof. Elm
goals.notes: Stand at (7,5) in the lab, face up, A opens the starter screen (map 43.7, a custom carousel: Right = Totodile, Left = Cyndaquil, A confirms the centred Chikorita, then Yes/No). scenes.py decides; run with --starter NAME to force it. The nickname prompt is answered with the default name.
